purpose: PR16 offline fixed candidate full-workflow opportunity and attribution; no network training or tuning.
selection: First and middle eligible factual nearest-policy decisions with at least two CP-SAT plans; at most two per scene, no backfill.
replay: Force a candidate at the factual decision tick, then nearest_batch. Key service noise by fixed simulation seed, sample ID, phase, station. Same public outage plan, task releases, PIBT and LaCAM3.
outcome: Completion count descending, then restricted mean job flow ascending, then original candidate index. Step regret only when all candidates complete.
cluster: Map and seed; three regimes form one dependent cluster.

robust_replays_if_large_gap.status: manual-gated; only if a fair same-prefix noise-only rerun implementation is validated

exclusion_rule: Keep all states and failed candidates in raw results; never silently discard failures or zero opportunity.
note: Perfect-State uses the true first N post-action observations only to score each candidate. No future data is exposed to Rule/PETS/Structured.
